newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Navan names Calver as chief executive.
newsitem.headline: Navan names Calver as chief executive.

text.p: Navan Resources Plc said on Tuesday that Brian Calver is replacing Paul Mihalop as chief executive officer and managing director with immediate effect.
Mihalop will remain on the board in a non-executive role but will assist Calver on certain specific development matters, Navan said in a statement.
The company said a four-man executive is now in place comprising Calver, Colin Andrew, David Mongey and Chris Neal.
Andrew will have responsibility for Navan's operations in Bulgaria and will take charge of Hungary around the middle of the year.
Neal has executive responsibility for Navan's operations in Spain and Portugal while Mongey remains group finance director.

"These changes are aimed at both focusing and optimising the investments made to date, in particular in Bulgaria and Spain, and on continuing the asset growth of the group throughout Europe," the company said.
